policy: Owner-approved visual design baseline for the user-directed retirement of the learner-facing Process Data screens and duplicate entry points. The owner asked to remove the Process Data interface while preserving the data behind it and requested merge. The exact-source comparison captured all 52 viewport/surface screens; five expected Practice/Home changes reflect that requested UI removal and 47 matched the previous approved reference. The new reference retains the 12-pixel threshold, all four viewports and all thirteen surfaces. This approval is limited to this UI retirement; independent assistive-technology, physical-device, Windows distribution, SME, learner-outcome, provider/NZQA and production reviews remain HOLD.
